english.title: Driver of a relevant vehicle fail to carry evidence of CPC or national return to driving course
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a relevant vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), and a person who was required by virtue of regulation 9(4) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007 to hold a CPC, a national periodic CPC or a Swiss CPC, or to have completed a national return to driving course, failed to carry in that vehicle evidence of that CPC, national periodic CPC, Swiss CPC or completion of that national return to driving course as specified in regulation 11(2) of those regulations in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11(1) and (8) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.

english.notes:
(i) These regulations apply to persons driving a bus on or after 10th September 2008 or driving a lorry on or after 10th September 2009.
(ii) See regulation 3(2) for vehicles to which these regulations DO NOT apply.
(iii) Being the holder of a certificate etc as required by the regulation may be evidenced by possession and production of any of the documents outlined in regulation 11(2).
(iv) This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/1160 to the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
